template_data.headline_html: Five things owners get wrong about certs.

items.title: No cert required for the Schedule
items.sub: GSA is open to any qualified small business — certifications are accelerants, not prerequisites

items.title: 8(a) is a program, not a badge
items.sub: Development track, reporting obligations, eight-year sunset — know what you're committing to

items.title: WOSB and SDVOSB are NAICS-specific
items.sub: Set-asides only apply in codes where those firms are underrepresented — check the list first

items.title: HUBZone needs ongoing physical presence
items.sub: Principal office and 35% of employees must stay in a designated zone; maps can redraw

items.title: No required order — run both in parallel
items.sub: Cert and Schedule in parallel typically saves six months over running them back-to-back
